messages.subject: Wallace v1.9 (beta testing of what will become v2!)
parts:
The Wallace development team and several external partners are ready for beta testing and feedback on a redesigned and expanded version.

What is new in this version?

  1. Stop and start your work whenever you want.
  2. Greater reproducibility regarding occurrence records.
  3. Cross-time projections.
  4. Make models for multiple species in the same Wallace session.
  5. Environmental space comparisons.
  6. Redesigned R-markdown functionalities.
  7. ... and more

Do you want to know more about beta testing?

Please take a look at this google document. It includes instructions for installation, a video showing the new features, and options to report bugs.

(Spanish) Intrucciones y video en español en la segunda parte del documento.


Best,
